messages:
jordan_sales: FYI -- Carol from RidgeBank wants an on‑prem, air‑gapped POC. They need clarity on packaging, upgrade cadence, and how billing works for a sealed install. Can we triage?

maria_solutions: Thanks Jordan. @vikram_engineer can you confirm minimal bundle options and install flow? Also: customer asked if we can avoid any outbound telemetry.

vikram_engineer: We have two bundle flavors: full operator (3.2GB) and slim runtime (850MB) that uses an external model repo. For air‑gapped we usually ship signed delta bundles + SBOM. Telemetry can be toggled off via `REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=0` and we provide an offline validation script.

andrew_ops: Quick note on install windows: customers usually want a zero‑egress bootstrap. We supply a USB/OCI tarball and an offline activation token flow that runs entirely in the DMZ. Bootstrapping steps look like:```
1. `scp bundle.tar.gz jumpbox:/tmp`
2. `tar xzf bundle.tar.gz -C /opt/redwood`
3. `sudo ./install-offline.sh --token /tmp/activation.jwt`
```

carol_cust: Confirming they want no contact to cloud during POC and a guaranteed monthly patch window. Also need estimate on time to apply a critical hotfix.

vikram_engineer: For hotfixes we can provide signed patch artifacts. Typical hotfix apply time (patch + restart) is ~15–30 min for the runtime, 45–60 min if operator components need upgrade. We support roll‑forward only by default for sealed sites; rollback requires preapproved snapshots.

maria_solutions: On cadence: we usually recommend quarterly bundled updates for POCs, with ad‑hoc security hotfixes as exceptions. We can offer monthly small deltas if they want more frequent security patches (adds operational overhead).

carol_cust: And billing? They asked whether POC is usage billed or a flat seat/license.

jordan_sales: RidgeBank POC is sales‑assisted. We can offer: 30d free trial credits, then a time‑boxed POC rate (flat monthly seat/license) or convert to reserved capacity if they want persistent throughput guarantees.

maria_solutions: Pricing note: air‑gapped onsite installs have a one‑time packaging & signing fee (for SBOM, signature keys, and per‑bundle QA). Add on: optional offline support seat for on‑call coverage. I'll put numbers in the SOW draft.

samantha_security: Security checklist items they asked in the questionnaire: KMS integration for key wrapping, support for HSM-attested signing, offline cert rotation process, SBOM format (CycloneDX), and proof of file integrity. We should confirm: do we support FIPS mode for the POC environment?

vikram_engineer: We support HSM/KMS integrations in Private deployments. For the POC we can use customer‑provided signing keys or use a sealed signing workflow where we sign artifacts prior to handoff. FIPS mode is supported on the runtime if they enable it at build time — requires a different bundle (adds ~120MB).

carol_cust: They also want SLA language for patch turnaround during the POC. Can we commit to a 48h security hotfix window?

maria_solutions: For POCs we can commit to best‑effort 48h for critical vuln fixes and a guaranteed 7‑day window for high severity if we have support seat. We can include a 48h clause in the POC SOW if sales covers the expedited support add‑on.

andrew_ops: Operational constraints to flag: network ACLs needed on the jumpbox, disk space minimums (`/opt/redwood` >= 50GB), and a allowed downtime window for operator upgrades. Also need maintenance access or an SRE chaperone during first upgrade.

carol_cust: Good. Can you confirm what we must sign/approve before we hand off the bundle? Legal needs an artifact manifest and notarized SBOM.

maria_solutions: We'll produce: signed bundle tarball, CycloneDX SBOM, SHA256 manifest, and a short runbook. Legal will get a notarized cover letter. I can attach the sample manifest to the SOW.

vikram_engineer: Example manifest snippet:```
{"bundle":"redwood-airgap-2026-03-21.tar.gz","sha256":"e3b0c442...","signed_by":"redwood-signer-v1","sbom":"redwood-2026-03-21.cdx.json"}
```

deploy_bot: Reminder: Meeting scheduled with RidgeBank on 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC to review handoff checklist. :calendar:

jordan_sales: Thanks team — action items: @maria_solutions draft SOW (include packaging fee + support seat options), @vikram_engineer produce slim + fips bundle examples and patch/runbook, @samantha_security prepare responses for KMS/HSM and cert rotation Qs. Carol, I'll loop you in on the SOW by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

carol_cust: Awesome — appreciate the quick turnaround.

maria_solutions: Will do. I'll drop a short checklist doc in the thread and ping ops for the maintenance window options.

vikram_engineer: I'll also add exact upgrade step commands and an emergency rollback playbook (needs preapproved snapshots).

samantha_security: I'll attach a one‑page security appendix for the questionnaire and note FIPS implications.

jordan_sales: Closing the loop here — feel free to DM for anything urgent.
